flowContents.comments: Self-healing test pack: Holdout: identity, onboarding and auctions. Built by flows/build_all.py.
flowContents.name: nfh-p27-holdout-b

processGroups.comments: S107 Verify Identity retries its transient failures with YIELD_PROCESSOR up to 5 minutes, so each failure stalls both tasks and the checks back up. (symptom: failure_loop)
processGroups.name: S107 Identity Service Backoff Stalls

processGroups.comments: Malformed applications fail S108 Parse KYC Document and are routed straight back into it, so they pile up on the loop for good, retried on every run. (symptom: failure_loop)
processGroups.name: S108 Malformed Applications Loop Forever

processGroups.comments: For 15 minutes every third hour an auction burst adds 15/s to 3/s of bids, into a recorder that does 8/s: its queue fills, drains, and fills again with the next burst. (symptom: backlog)
processGroups.name: S109 Auction Bursts Swamp The Recorder

processGroups.comments: None. Each sensor alert is copied once per subscriber, twenty in all, and the dispatcher keeps up with the 10/s that makes. (symptom: healthy)
processGroups.name: S110 Alert Fan-out Within Capacity
